name: The Sallowmere
setting: The Sallowmere is a lowland of rivers, reed and ruined temples that has been drowning for eleven years. The rain has not stopped in all that time, and the floodwaters climb a finger's width each week. Hollowmoot, a crowded stilt-town, is the last real settlement; the Ashwater Causeway is its only dry road north, and Gullet Ford the only crossing south. A blight called the hive spreads through wounds and bad water, making its victims hive-touched: feral, pain-blind, and drawn to a swarm-song that seems to come from the flooded belltower of Saint Orrin's Drowned Temple. The shrunken Order of the Dry Saint guards what lore survives, while a renegade Drowned Priest preaches that the hive is holy. The Causeway Wardens burn infected houses and tax every crossing, the Blackwater Cartel smuggles food and people through hidden cellars, and the Stiltfolk Clans watch it all from the reeds. Play it grounded: cold hands, wet rope, hard choices about who gets the last dry bed.

cards.title: Endless Rain
cards.blurb: The rain never stops in the Sallowmere; it rots food, hides footprints and makes every road a slog.

cards.title: The Hive Blight
cards.blurb: A creeping blight that makes the infected feral and bound to a distant swarm-song; smoke and fire drive it back.

cards.title: Rising Floodwaters
cards.blurb: The marsh swells a little more each week; fords vanish, roads drown and the dead float up.

cards.title: Sucking Mire
cards.blurb: Bottomless black mud under innocent-looking reed mats; the old pilings are the only safe line.

cards.title: Marsh Fever
cards.blurb: A shaking fever from foul water that saps strength and brings visions easily mistaken for the blight.

cards.title: Collapsing Temple Stones
cards.blurb: Waterlogged temple masonry that can drop a floor or a ceiling at the worst moment.

cards.title: Hive-Touched Pack
cards.blurb: Villagers taken by the blight who now hunt in packs along the fords with the hooked spears they once fished with.

cards.title: The Hive Mother
cards.blurb: Something vast and patient in the flooded belltower of Saint Orrin's; the swarm-song is her voice.

cards.title: Cartel Enforcers
cards.blurb: Blackwater Cartel muscle who collect debts, guard cargo and break anyone who talks.

cards.title: The Drowned Priest
cards.blurb: A renegade priest of the Dry Saint who teaches that the hive is salvation and feeds the faithful to it.

cards.title: The Pikemaw
cards.blurb: A pike the size of a barge that haunts the deep channels near Gullet Ford.

cards.title: The Blackwater Cartel
cards.blurb: The smuggling cartel that moves food, medicine and people through the flooded region for a ruinous price.

cards.title: Order of the Dry Saint
cards.blurb: The old temple order, shrunken and frightened, that still holds the only dry ground and the oldest books.

cards.title: The Causeway Wardens
cards.blurb: Hollowmoot's militia, too few and too scared, who keep order with tolls, chains and torches.

cards.title: The Stiltfolk Clans
cards.blurb: Marsh clans living in stilt villages who know the water better than anyone and trust no one from the dry roads.

cards.title: Gullet Ford
cards.blurb: The main crossing of the Sallow river, narrow, fast and overlooked by tall reeds.

cards.title: Saint Orrin's Drowned Temple
cards.blurb: The great temple of the Dry Saint, now half under water, its belltower the only part still dry.

cards.title: Hollowmoot
cards.blurb: The last real town, built on pilings, crowded with refugees and suspicion.

cards.title: The Ashwater Causeway
cards.blurb: A raised stone road across open water, gated by the Wardens and watched from both ends.

cards.title: The Wick Lane Cellars
cards.blurb: Linked cellars under Hollowmoot's Wick Lane where the cartel keeps its goods and its secrets.

cards.title: Hide From Weather
cards.blurb: No one refuses a dry hearth by day, but after dusk every door in the marsh is barred.

cards.title: Burn the Touched
cards.blurb: Fear of the blight has made informing and burning a civic duty.

cards.title: Every Crossing Owes
cards.blurb: Nothing crosses water for free here; debts are inherited and collected.

cards.title: Pray to the Dry Saint
cards.blurb: Folk still pray to the saint who promised dry land, and follow anyone wearing his colours.

beat_frames.name: AMBUSH

defaults.HOW: hooked spears thrust from the reed banks
defaults.WHY: they are starving and the party carries food

beat_frames.stakes: A companion or pack animal is dragged into the water and the party's food and dry gear are lost.

beat_frames.name: PLEA FOR HELP
beat_frames.sentence: {WHO} begs the party to go to {WHERE}, because {WHY}.

defaults.WHY: her son followed the swarm-song into the belltower

beat_frames.stakes: The one they came to save is lost to the hive and Hollowmoot blames the party.

beat_frames.name: BETRAYAL

defaults.WHY: the Blackwater Cartel has put a price on the party

beat_frames.stakes: The party loses its route, its coin or a hostage to the cartel.

beat_frames.name: RIVAL CLAIM
beat_frames.sentence: {WHO} seizes the party's goal at {WHERE} using {HOW}.

defaults.WHERE: the reliquary crypt under Saint Orrin's
defaults.HOW: a crowd of fervent pilgrims as a human wall

beat_frames.stakes: The goal passes into the Drowned Priest's hands and his following grows.

beat_frames.name: FALSE SANCTUARY

defaults.HOW: a hive-touched family locked in the loft

beat_frames.stakes: Someone in the party is exposed to the blight and the Wardens mark them for burning.

beat_frames.name: BAD NEWS
beat_frames.sentence: {WHO} arrives with word that {WHY} has happened.

defaults.WHY: the Ashwater Causeway has been cut by the flood

beat_frames.stakes: The party's way home is cut and they must pay the cartel or wait out the water.

gm_story_pile.title: Mother Hessaly, Ford Warden
gm_story_pile.blurb: The old warden of Gullet Ford, kind to strays and deep in debt to the cartel.

gm_story_pile.title: Brother Caddock
gm_story_pile.blurb: A gentle young acolyte of the Dry Saint hiding blight marks under his sleeves.

gm_story_pile.title: Ottile Brand, Cartel Lieutenant
gm_story_pile.blurb: The Blackwater Cartel's sharpest lieutenant, patient and ambitious.

gm_story_pile.title: Captain Rusk Varro
gm_story_pile.blurb: Captain of the Causeway Wardens, hard, tired and one bad night from panic.

gm_story_pile.title: Yarrow Nine-Poles
gm_story_pile.blurb: A Stiltfolk trader who will guide outsiders for the right gossip.

gm_story_pile.title: Old Tamsin the Bell-Ringer
gm_story_pile.blurb: A half-touched old woman who still climbs a Hollowmoot bell tower to warn of what the hive plans.

gm_story_pile.title: Who Is Feeding the Hive?
gm_story_pile.blurb: Someone is deliberately delivering people to the hive-touched.

gm_story_pile.title: Where Did Hollowmoot's Children Go?
gm_story_pile.blurb: Six children vanished from Hollowmoot in a single night.

gm_story_pile.title: Is There a Cure in the Reliquary?
gm_story_pile.blurb: Rumour says the Dry Saint left a cure for the blight in his crypt.

gm_story_pile.title: What Sank the Causeway Barge?
gm_story_pile.blurb: A cartel barge full of grain went down near the Causeway with no storm to blame.
